surrealdb_authority_v02_205.supersedes: Any PostgreSQL/PgPool/sqlx/SQL-DDL/RLS/JSONB proof or implementation assumption in the pre-pivot DW design.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.implementation_rule: Durable workspace records, leases, snapshots and recovery state use MT-331..334 SurrealDB boundaries; privacy proof uses MT-333 record-user context plus ResourceBroker.
surrealdb_authority_v02_205.postgresql_data_migration: NOT_REQUIRED: no valuable live information exists in PostgreSQL; no connection, import, fallback or proof path is allowed.

title: DW-MT329-CrashRecoveryAndReattachProof
group: DW Durable workspace volumes and handoff
clause: Prove crash-safe durable-volume recovery, workspace reattachment and no-loss handoff against canonical SurrealDB state.

scope.summary: Run the DW family recovery matrix: graceful close, VMM kill, guest crash, host-process crash, interrupted export, interrupted promotion and restart. Reattach the exact named durable volume from SurrealDB registry/lease state, verify filesystem and CAS hashes, resume incomplete exports idempotently, and prove unpromoted work is never swept. VM snapshots are resume accelerators only; durable volume bytes plus SurrealDB/EventLedger state are authority.
forbidden_paths: PostgreSQL/SQLite authority, fallback, connection, fixture, or proof path
acceptance_criteria: Each failure point is injected live and recovery is driven from SurrealDB canonical rows plus verified filesystem/CAS state.
Unpromoted leased work survives every crash and GC cycle; promotion is idempotent and never duplicates EventLedger receipts.
Cross-account reattach is denied by record permissions and ResourceBroker.
A clean restart reattaches the correct volume/worktree/VM identity and reproduces the last committed state hash.
proof_targets: Focused real-runtime DW crash/restart matrix with scoped external artifacts and CARGO_TARGET_DIR.
SurrealDB canonical reread of registry, lease, promotion and EventLedger heads after each recovery.

argus_targets: recoverable, recovering, recovered and blocked states

target_entries: Workspace volumes > Crash recovery and reattach

risk_if_missed: A workspace can appear durable while crashes orphan, leak or garbage-collect unpromoted operator work.

risks: registry says attached while bytes are stale
snapshot is mistaken for data authority
minimum_controls: canonical SurrealDB reread plus hash verification
lease-fenced GC with second reachability check
volume bytes and EventLedger remain authority

surrealdb_translation_v02_205.schema_rule: Any embedded PostgreSQL DDL/SQL snippet is a semantic field/index/invariant inventory only. Implement it as SCHEMAFULL SurrealQL through SurrealKit; do not execute or mechanically transliterate the snippet.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.concurrency_rule: Translate advisory locks, SKIP LOCKED and row locks into SurrealDB transactions, durable lease/fencing records and conditional updates with equivalent tests.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.notification_rule: Translate LISTEN/NOTIFY into scoped SurrealDB live queries plus bounded resynchronization.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.privacy_rule: Translate RLS into authenticated record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker; administrative credentials cannot prove privacy.
surrealdb_translation_v02_205.proof_rule: All named storage proofs run against real SurrealDB. No PostgreSQL process, driver, connection, fixture, environment variable or fallback is permitted.
